subject: sci-dym
title: SCI.DYM.------WO.EXP.PRI.
description: Chart on book p. 58 (BK(NM)-34). SCI-DYM (scientific dynamics) is the subject; WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) is the partner. From the subject: EXT-FT (extended functionalism), INDIV-DY (individual dynamics) and ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism). From EXT-FT: TECH-DY (technological dynamics). From TECH-DY: APL-DY. From APL-DY: AF-NT (affinity nature). From INDIV-DY: MOT-DY and REL-TECH (relevant technology). From ACC-FT: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From T-C-IMP: SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars).
